description: This file is a C++ header defining internal prefetch functions for the Abseil library, providing wrappers around compiler and architecture-specific prefetch instructions to optimize data cache usage.

methods.name: PrefetchT1
methods.description: Prefetch data with moderate temporal locality, using compiler built-in or architecture-specific instructions.

methods.name: PrefetchT2
methods.description: Prefetch data with low temporal locality, using compiler built-in or architecture-specific instructions.

methods.name: PrefetchNta
methods.description: Prefetch data with no temporal locality, wrapper around internal cache prefetch function.

methods.name: PrefetchT0
methods.description: Prefetch data with high temporal locality, wrapper around internal cache prefetch function.
